_doc: globalFitRenormPF: renormalised PF fractions and pre-combined PF and HDM inputs, written into the pre-fit file (was globalFitRenormPF.C). Object names are templates relative to the pre-fit file ({tier}, {var}, {set}, {epoch}). Not used by the fit today. Dropped from the macro: the 2017H branch (other sets, scaleRes-only HDM variant) and the Run2Test exception (no incjet).

renormalize._inputsNote: the first that exists (a30 for pfjet)
renormalize._note: data and MC: fraction / (chf+nef+nhf); ratio: data - MC of the renormalised fractions

default._ptBinsNote: binning of the pre-combined results: Z/W only up to 60, +gamjet from 70, multijet above 500

precombinePF._minPtNote: bins with a lower edge below this are not used for the set
precombinePF._note: per pT bin: constant fit to each set, inverse-variance average; outputs <output> (graph), _stat, _syst (RMS) and _tot

precombineHDM._multijetNote: added last (it refers to the combination of the sets before it) in the variants with addMJ
precombineHDM._variantsNote: outputs hdm_cmb[_mj][_res], _syst and _tot; scaleRes multiplies by the L2L3Res band herr_l2l3res
